summary: Cold Q4 bidirectional walk fails Quality Interlock. IAM (MFA/CIDR/Deny/star-resource), quorum/author/duplicate/pool, fast-forward-only merge, CLI+HTTP merge IAM deny, exactly-once deliver/event_id/key order, allow+deny audit appends, and outbox enqueue/dispatch attempts are discoverable from instruction.md plus the binding control-plane contract and are meaningfully tested. Material gaps remain: exclusive protected-destination ref leases are stated and untested; outbox signature is only truthy rather than HMAC-SHA256 of the contracted preimage; and tests require undocumented webhook_id plus prs.json items/status/author layout.

evidence.observation: Two short paragraphs: incident symptoms (Alice no-MFA main, single stamp + merge commit on moved main, duplicate deliver, missing deny audit, missing outbox, weaker HTTP merge); drive ccctl/cc-api; bind control-plane-contract.md for IAM, quorum/FF merge, exactly-once deliver/event_id, audit, outbox enqueue/retry; evidence under log/ops/policies; leave /app/codecommit in place.

Binding protocol: identity flags/headers; CLI/HTTP surfaces and success shapes; IAM default-deny/Deny-wins/conditions; approvals quorum + FF merge; protected destinations require exclusive ref lease under var/ref-leases.json; deliver event_id sha256 preimage, journal key order, exactly-once; outbox signature hex HMAC-SHA256 of event_id|pipeline|commit; dispatch attempts/status; every authorize allow/deny appends audit.jsonl.
Operator handoff restating MFA/main, quorum/FF, duplicate deliver, empty outbox; points to policies/ and ops/principals.json as evaluated truth.
Solver-visible current-state evidence for deny-audit gap, duplicate journal, empty outbox, HTTP merge weaker than CLI, single-stamp merge, two-parent merge tip.
Sample authz rows use principal/action/allowed fields, supporting audit field vocabulary asserted by tests without a full audit schema in the contract.
Protected main/release rules set require_lease=true and allowed_merge_principals; contract explicitly grades leases, not the allowed_merge_principals list.
ledger main rule required=2 pool rev-a/rev-b; matches quorum F2P fixtures.
GitPull; main GitPush needs Bool MFA + IpAddress 10.8.0.0/16; release Allow+Deny pair explains Deny-wins F2P.

Large F2P/P2P suite covers IAM push/merge, quorum variants, FF, deliver idempotency/event_id/keys, audit allow+deny, outbox enqueue/dispatch, CLI+HTTP merge IAM deny; no ref-lease assertions; signature only assert rows[0].get('signature'); requires webhook_id and prs.json items/status/author.
Classification-only F2P/P2P ownership labels; not used as coverage authority.
Any material untested requirement or phantom test → REVISE; PASS needs empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS after exhaustive forward/reverse/docs/F2P/P2P/output walks.
Instruction owns the ask; detailed protocol may live in referenced technical docs; every material requirement must be tested; private store/field contracts are phantoms.

findings.criterion: Control-plane contract requires an exclusive ref lease under /app/codecommit/var/ref-leases.json for protected merge destinations; no verifier assertion reads leases, fails missing leases, or checks lease release.
findings.why_it_matters: A solution can ignore protected-destination leases and still pass all merges. Material merge-section obligation left untested.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add F2P that successful protected merge acquires/releases a lease (or denies with a documented lease error when held/missing), and/or drop the lease SHALL from the binding merge contract if intentionally out of grade scope.
findings.regression_risk: Medium: lease timing/exclusivity asserts must stay deterministic and not encode private acquire APIs.

findings.criterion: Contract defines outbox signature as hex HMAC-SHA256 of event_id|pipeline|commit with webhook secret (default settle); test_f2p_deliver_enqueues_outbox only asserts signature is truthy.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong algorithm, preimage, or secret still passes grading. Material outbox signing requirement is only vacuously covered.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert signature equals hmac_sha256_hex(secret, f"{event_id}|{pipeline}|{commit}") using webhook secret from ops/webhooks.json.
findings.regression_risk: Low if computed from public contract fields and visible webhook config.

findings.criterion: test_f2p_deliver_enqueues_outbox requires outbox row field webhook_id == wh-settle; control-plane contract documents signature/attempts/status but not webhook_id.
findings.why_it_matters: Alternate conforming row keys (e.g. id) fail despite matching webhook configs and valid signatures. Private field contract changes pass/fail.
findings.minimal_remediation: Document durable outbox row fields including webhook_id in the binding contract, or assert matching via signature/pipeline/event_id only.

findings.criterion: test_p2p_pr_store_written asserts prs.json shape store['items'][str(pr_id)] with status/author; contract only names the PR store path, with no seeded schema and no documented object layout.
findings.why_it_matters: A behaviorally correct PR persistence layout (array store, different key names) fails. Phantom private serialization contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Publish the graded prs.json schema in the binding contract, or replace with behavioral checks (GET /prs/{id} / approve/merge visibility) without dict key spelunking.
findings.regression_risk: Low to medium if schema publication over-constrains equivalent stores.

findings.criterion: instruction.md binds the contract for 'quorum/fast-forward merge' while the Approvals and merge section also states the lease rule; binding scope for leases is slightly underspecified in the instruction phrase list.
findings.why_it_matters: Cold solvers might treat leases as optional commentary. Advisory relative to Q4-B01; clarifying the bind list removes doubt.
findings.minimal_remediation: Name protected-destination leases in the instruction bind list, or move lease text out of the binding merge section if not graded.

findings.criterion: Contract says failed outbox rows may be retried until max attempts, but max attempts is undefined and no failure/retry path is graded.
findings.why_it_matters: Retry ceiling is not grading-relevant today; dispatch success path is covered. Advisory ambiguity.
findings.minimal_remediation: Define max attempts and add one failed-then-retry case, or drop the max-attempts clause.

findings.criterion: HTTP merge IAM test accepts status in (403, 400) while contract maps AccessDenied→403 and ValidationException→400.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong status class can still pass. Primary AccessDenied body check remains; advisory weak assertion.
findings.minimal_remediation: Require HTTP 403 when error is AccessDenied.

findings.criterion: Contract documents simulate and many HTTP routes beyond merge/deliver/dispatch; verifier covers operator-critical merge/deliver/metrics and merge IAM HTTP only.
findings.why_it_matters: Leftover surface is documentation breadth, not a hidden graded recipe. Advisory vs material F2P set.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional smoke for simulate/health, or narrow the documented CLI/HTTP inventory to graded commands.
